test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

They **will __took their__** grandchildren to the zoo.
solution:
The correct answer is "take their."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb **"will took." **
 
• The modal verb** "will" **is always followed by the V1 form of the verb.
 
• **Structure: Subject + will + V1 +Object**
 
• **"Will"** is the auxiliary verb, and **"take"** is the base form of the main verb, creating the future tense.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: *They will **take their**__ grandchildren to the zoo.*
